children: Alcoa proposed a $2.6 billion offering of senior notes to help fund the roughly $3.1 billion cash portion of its planned acquisition of South32 assets.
Proposed $2.6B aggregate principal amount of senior notes (2034 and 2036 maturities) to be issued by two wholly-owned subsidiaries.
Net proceeds, together with cash on hand, intended to fund the ~$3.1B cash consideration for the Acquisition and related fees.
Notes will be senior unsecured, guaranteed by Alcoa and certain subsidiaries; pricing and terms subject to market conditions.
Alcoa updated pro forma financials to reflect $2.6B in notes plus cash on hand and included closing price as of Sept 2, 2026.
Completion of the Acquisition remains subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Alcoa proposes $2.6B senior notes to help fund $3.1B cash for South32 asset acquisition
